# Anker Prime A83B5 — 14-in-1 Thunderbolt 5 Docking Station

**Category:** Docking Station
**MSRP:** $399.99

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Model number | A83B5 |
| Host interface | Thunderbolt 5 (backward compatible with Thunderbolt 4 hosts; not compatible with Thunderbolt 3) |
| Max bandwidth | Up to 120Gbps (Thunderbolt 5 Bandwidth Boost) |
| Upstream port | 1 × Thunderbolt 5, 140W max host charging (PD 3.1) |
| Downstream Thunderbolt | 2 × Thunderbolt 5, 15W each |
| USB-A | 3 × USB-A, 10Gbps |
| USB-C | 2 × USB-C, 10Gbps, 45W shared (front; charging/data only, no video) |
| Video out | 1 × HDMI 2.1 or 1 × DisplayPort 2.1 (only one usable at a time) |
| Max display output | Single 8K@60Hz; dual 8K@60Hz on Thunderbolt 5 Windows hosts; dual 6K@60Hz or dual 4K@144Hz on Thunderbolt 5 MacBook Pro |
| Triple display | Supported in hardware (2 × TB5 + HDMI/DP) but host-dependent; very few laptops support it |
| Ethernet | 1 × 2.5Gbps RJ45 |
| Card readers | 1 × SD, 1 × TF (microSD), UHS-I |
| Audio | 1 × 3.5mm audio combo jack |
| Power | Built-in power supply, AC input (6 ft AC cable included) |
| Cooling | Smart active cooling system |
| Lighting | Interactive ambient blue LED, toggle button |
| Firmware updates | Anker Dock Manager app (one-click, auto-detect) |
| OS compatibility | Windows 10 / 11 (23H2 recommended), macOS 15 or later; no ChromeOS or Linux support |
| Host devices | Thunderbolt 5 / 4 laptops |
| Dimensions | 4.6 × 4.6 × 3.0 in / 116 × 116 × 75 mm |
| Weight | 38 oz / 1,086 g |
| In the box | Dock, 3.3 ft Thunderbolt 5 cable, 6 ft AC power cable, safety sheet |
| Warranty | 24 months |

## Notable Features
- One of the first Thunderbolt 5 docks on the market — up to 120Gbps bandwidth, roughly 3× Thunderbolt 4
- 140W PD 3.1 upstream charging, enough for 16-inch MacBook Pro and most large Windows laptops at full speed
- Internal power supply eliminates the external brick; Mac mini–like square aluminum form factor
- Dual 8K@60Hz output on TB5 Windows hosts; dual 6K@60Hz or dual 4K@144Hz on TB5 MacBook Pro
- Active cooling keeps sustained throughput stable under full load
- 2.5GbE wired networking (backward compatible with Gigabit)
- Anker Dock Manager app for remote firmware updates
- Noteworthy limitations: HDMI 2.1 and DP 2.1 are mutually exclusive; front USB-C ports carry no video; no Thunderbolt 3, ChromeOS, or Linux support; base M1/M2/M3 MacBooks limited to one external display
